runner: MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free via the opencode agent
notes: Vanilla canvas 2D, no libraries. Dusk highway with eleven depth planes: painted sky with a low sun and glow band, stratus streaks, two mountain ridges, a conifer treeline, rolling hills with tree clumps, utility poles with sagging catenary wires, roadside trees, a guardrail with a sign, a grass verge, tarmac with wrapped aggregate and periodic tar seams, lane dashes and an out-of-focus foreground grass strip. Every layer is a pre-rendered tile that wraps on its own width, so the scenery repeats without a seam. The fastback coupe is one closed silhouette path with punched wheel arches, a gradient body, sun-side wash, rim light, glass with reflection sweep, chrome trim, headlights and taillight. Wheels spin with distance travelled; the body heaves and pitches on a summed-sine road profile per axle. Seeded RNG keeps the layout deterministic. Verified in Chrome: no console errors.
